description: Image Description: The image depicts a train traveling on a set of railway tracks. The train consists of a locomotive at the front, painted in a red and yellow color scheme, followed by a series of passenger cars. The passenger cars have a green and cream color scheme. The train appears to be moving away from the viewer along a double set of tracks. Overhead, there are electric lines supported by metal pylons, indicating the railway is electrified. The surrounding area features grassy terrain with sparse vegetation
